campaign: DeepSeekV4 decode CSA PyPTO L1 TRB ACLGraph mature-context steady-state performance acceptance

target.native_path: production vllm::dsa_forward with default multistream overlap enabled

source.production_python_tree_sha256_method: sha256 of the sorted sha256sum listing for vllm_ascend/ops/_pypto_dsv4_csa/*.py
source.post_measurement_source_change: After the device campaign, Ruff mechanically reformatted ten task files, lint-only local identifiers/comments were clarified, and a static ABI regression assertion was added. The measured program semantics are unchanged; measured and current hashes are retained separately rather than rewriting provenance.
source.scope_note: All task implementation changes are in vllm-ascend. PyPTO and Simpler are read-only references for this task.

protocol.caller_quiesce: stream synchronize after at most 20 enqueues
protocol.state_worlds: independent equal weights/input; disjoint mutable caches/output
protocol.paired_difference_definition: Dq = native_device_span_q - pypto_device_span_q; positive means PyPTO is faster
protocol.aggregation: For each quantile, take the median of the three fresh-process paired differences; raw samples are not pooled across processes and medians are not subtracted after aggregation.
protocol.steady_state_statistics: Only SamplingPhase.SAMPLE contributes to p50/p90/p99. SamplingPhase.WARMUP and all cold setup are excluded.

timing_scope.primary_device_span_semantics: Pre-created same-stream NPU timing events surround each complete ACLGraph replay. The ordered start/replay/end sequence covers taskQueue consumer dequeue and launch gaps, device scheduling, and kernel execution. Native auxiliary-stream work joins the caller stream before the tail event.
timing_scope.host_enqueue_semantics: The exact graph.replay producer-side enqueue is measured separately. It overlaps device_span and must not be added to it.
included_in_primary_path: all steady-state work that occurs between same-stream start and end events
taskQueue consumer dequeue and captured-node launch
child-kernel execution, dependency retirement, barriers, and inter-child gaps
any tensor-address, scalar, KernelArgs, or runtime patch work repeated inside the captured/runtime path
native production auxiliary-stream branches through their mandatory join
excluded_from_primary_samples: PTOAS, code generation, and binary materialization or registration
runtime, context, owner, callable creation, and prepare
ordinary eager, ACLGraph, and benchmark warmup
first invocation or replay at the final sampled addresses
one-time structure-cache, binding-cache, event-pool, or runtime-handle initialization
correctness golden generation, execution, comparison, and validation-only copies
phase-reset copies and backend-independent input preparation
caller synchronization used only to collect already-completed timing events
sample aggregation, JSON serialization, and reporting
timing_scope.captured_argument_note: The campaign replays one captured B4/S8 tensor/scalar binding. It does not require or fake per-replay Python address/scalar patching, and therefore proves fixed-binding ACLGraph steady state only.
timing_scope.dynamic_argument_policy: If a future workload performs real Host validation, address/scalar patching, or binding-cache replacement before the start event, its primary metric must be the steady enqueue-batch critical path from the first backend-specific per-call operation through final caller-stream quiescence, divided by calls. Host enqueue and device_span remain non-additive attribution metrics.

aggregate_acceptance.interpretation: All three independent processes have positive D50, D90, and D99. The median paired differences satisfy all predeclared thresholds; the current PyPTO path therefore exceeds native production for this fixed-binding B4/S8/C8191 TRB ACLGraph steady-state target.

correctness_gates.scope: Every fresh process ran both pre-timing and post-timing comparison gates against an independent native state world.

retained_optimizations.name: wo_b tile-major cold packing
retained_optimizations.behavior: Preserve the public [D, G*K] shape while storing physical data as [G, D/N, K/BK, N, BK], allowing every 256x256 proj-b cube weight tile to use contiguous GM stride.
retained_optimizations.steady_state_effect: No per-call packing; prepared owner pins the packed tensor for eager and graph replay.
retained_optimizations.cost: Approximately 64 MiB additional pinned packed wo_b storage per layer while the original model parameter remains resident.

retained_optimizations.name: projection sibling submit order
retained_optimizations.behavior: Submit groups in [6,7,4,5,2,3,0,1] so A3's observed LIFO-like sibling scheduling aligns with merge tiles becoming ready in order 3,2,1,0. Mathematical dependencies and final deterministic group reduction order are unchanged.

retained_optimizations.name: indexer dequant plus RoPE child fusion
retained_optimizations.behavior: Fuse idx_qr_proj_dequant and qr_rope into idx_qr_dequant_rope, process each 32-head block as two smaller 16-head tiles, preserve native BF16 rounding boundaries, delete roughly 1 MiB of FP32 GM handoff, and remove one task barrier.

retained_optimizations.name: supporting retained critical-path changes
retained_optimizations.behavior: Mature-context qk planning, four merge head tiles, proj-a M32, group-major proj-a scratch, qproj M32, local zero bias, and batch-SPMD compressor scatter/pool with single-writer scale ownership remain part of the measured tree.

runtime_scope_limits.accepted_workload: A3 device0, TP1, B4/S8, ratio4, start-position 8191, fixed captured binding
runtime_scope_limits.hbg_policy: HBG is functionally checked but has no performance claim because current resident recording does not encode the task predicate as a native replay node and can use ordinary fallback.
not_established: full vLLM Engine or full-model throughput superiority

publication_blocker.issue: The NOTICE/provenance treatment for private kernel primitives derived from CANN Open Software License v2 versus the vLLM-Ascend Apache-2.0 root license is unresolved.
publication_blocker.effect: Functional code must not be presented as publication-ready or committed as such until maintainers approve the license treatment.
